BUILD/: plan.json as truth, PLAN.md and STATE.md generated, LEDGER.md and AMENDMENTS.md append-only
tools/gate.py: status, check, close, checkpoint, amend, ledger, render
CLAUDE.md at the repo root carrying the session rules

phases.title: Scope resolver
phases.intent: Five-layer resolution, deeper shadows shallower, overlays may only tighten. This is what makes 'an engagement can only see the skills its scope resolves to' true by construction rather than by policy.

phases.title: Graph compiler

phases.notes: Recipes, not a model, produce the plan until P26. Debugging plan compilation and a model's plan proposal at the same time means trusting neither.

phases.title: The assertion suites
phases.intent: The 25 invariants become tests that run in CI and before every execution, rather than properties of a picture that can be quietly wrong for months.

phases.notes: Two graphs, two suites. Conflating the 118-node architecture graph with the ~8-step plan graph is what made three assertions unsatisfiable in the blueprint's first draft.

phases.title: Step executor, idempotency, resume
phases.intent: A retry, a crash resume and a manual re-run after a fix are the same operation - and only the steps whose inputs actually changed are paid for twice.

Per-step timeout, one transport retry, then quarantine
A blocked run checkpoints and exits - no process, no lock, no context window held
exit: Killing a run mid-flight and resuming re-executes zero completed steps
A late result from a timed-out step cannot overwrite the retry that replaced it
A run blocked on a review item releases its lock and stops the wall-clock budget
Steps pass content-addressed refs, never values
phases.notes: The checkpoint-and-exit decision is what makes the '4h excluding time waiting on a human' budget honest.

phases.title: Context builder
phases.intent: Everything a model is shown is assembled in one place and recorded, so any call can be reconstructed exactly.

phases.title: Confidence router, review queue, decision log
phases.block: Block C - The harness around one step

And the whole point is that no model is in this path: masking happens after the text exists, so an adapter that reached one would invert the order the guarantee rests on.
